Ben/Aisha/Marcus — reviewed the customer's DPA redline. High level: we can accept a fallback but we need tight limits so this doesn't become a permanent license to route data out of SCCs. Key asks from Legal:

1) Narrow scope: fallback applies only to named subprocessors listed in a schedule and only for the minimum necessary processing while SCCs are being finalized.
2) Timebox: fallback must expire after a fixed remediation window (we recommend 90 days) plus one 30‑day extension with written notice and justification.
3) Mitigations: require encryption at rest with customer keys where available, logging of transfers, and monthly status reporting until SCCs are executed.
4) Evidence: customer needs a signed subprocessor inventory and region attestation. No open-ended delegation.

Suggested fallback clause (draft):
"If, despite good faith efforts, execution of the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for one or more identified subprocessors cannot be completed prior to the Service Effective Date, Customer and Provider agree as follows: (a) Provider will route Customer Personal Data for those specific subprocessors to Provider's dedicated capacity located in the EU (the 'EU Fallback') solely for the purpose of providing the Services listed in the Order Form; (b) the EU Fallback will be time-limited to ninety (90) calendar days from the Service Effective Date, with up to one thirty (30) day extension upon Customer's written request and Provider's reasonable consent; (c) Provider shall implement the following compensating measures during the EU Fallback: encryption at rest with Customer-controlled keys where supported, transfer logging and monthly remediation updates to Customer; and (d) the EU Fallback shall terminate immediately on execution of the applicable SCCs for the affected subprocessors."

Commercial note: any concession on timebox or key management requires Laura's approval; please don't agree to more than the above without escalation.

I've attached a redline (novamed_dpa_redline.docx) with inline edits and a short memo on evidence to provide (export_controls_summary.xlsx).
